title.es: El de cuando Fina se sobresalta

description.es: Mientras Fina y Marta desayunan en el jardín de Mafinca, Marta besa a Fina, y Fina se sobresalta. Marta dice que Fina no durmió a su lado anoche y que no quiere que le vea el cuerpo, y le pregunta qué le pasa, y discuten. Marta le pide a Carmen que visite a Fina. Claudia le pregunta a Marta por Fina; mientras Marta finge no saber nada, Carmen dice que Claudia ha entendido lo de su relación. Carmen va a Mafinca, pero, por algo que se dice durante la conversación, Fina se acuerda de Santiago, grita y sale corriendo.
description.en: As Fina and Marta are having breakfast in the garden at Mafinca, Marta kisses Fina, and Fina flinches. Marta says that Fina did not sleep beside her last night and does not want her to see her body, and asks what is wrong, and they argue. Marta asks Carmen to visit Fina. Claudia asks Marta about Fina; while Marta pretends not to know anything, Carmen says that Claudia has understood their relationship. Carmen goes to Mafinca, but because of something said during their conversation, Fina remembers Santiago, screams, and runs off.
